behavior: Every clickable element shows a pointer, presses do not move, the scrollbar and select are custom, the accordion opens one item at a time with a smooth animation, the code block has syntax colors, and the site never mentions generated images
acceptance: Given buttons, links, tabs, summary rows, selects and switches, then the cursor is a pointer (not-allowed when disabled) and pressing does not shift or scale them
Given the FAQ or any Accordion, when one item opens, then the open one closes, and items open and close with a height animation (instant under reduced motion)
Given SelectField, then it is a custom listbox styled with tokens (keyboard and screen-reader friendly), not the native select; the page scrollbar uses token colors and a slim custom style
Given CodeBlock, then code shows token-colored syntax highlighting in both themes; no page text says images are generated
